messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: ur5e-manual, p. 89

8. Installation 8.7. General Purpose Digital I/O Description The Startup screen contains settings for automatically loading and starting a default program, and for auto-initializing the Robot arm during power up. General This section describes the general purpose 24V I/O (Gray terminals) and the configurable purpose I/O (Yellow terminals with black text) when not configured as safety I/O. digital I/O The general purpose I/O can be used to drive equipment like pneumatic relays directly or for communication with other PLC systems. All Digital Outputs can be disabled automatically when program execution is stopped. In this mode, the output is always low when a program is not running.
